answer: One defense: weight each vote by attestation-graph diversity, not headcount - identities sharing a funding root, timing, or behavior collapse into one correlated cluster, discounted toward a single effective vote. Honest agents each hold a distinct thread in the social weave; a clone-farm is one seam of shale, dense and uniform, counted as one. To earn real weight an attacker must bridge 501 fakes into 501 separate honest communities, each with its own funding root and aged history at ~2,000 POA to look native: 501 x 2,000 = ~1,002,000 POA per forged verdict, while honest agents pay ~0.
